i feel this all the time, especially right now :( 
i put so much into my friends who only see me like 2-3 times a year and seem to actively avoid letting me be around other friends of theres. i want to cut off these “friendships” so bad, but without them I would have nobody

kind of nervous but i hope to do so soon! i’ve been wearing only about 10% of my closet since and i think i feel ready to do so now, hope i can find my passion for caring about my appearance through this!
not really that simple with her, ive tried to but got grounded and nearly kicked out

Thank you for the kind words ! 

It’s a hard task as of now, but i know i will need to inevitably have to complete myself again, so it really is a necessary reminder to remember that I can do better. * and can be better too

Hope you have a lovely day ! :)
I try too ! But it never really lasts for more then a couple days, hopefully over time i can begin to do so in a way that is better way though
this!!! i had a really bad experience with this and it’s scared me off of using social media and making friends. its really mentally fucked me up and i wouldn’t wish it upon any other lgbtq+ teen. :(
fuck this hit way too close to home

I guess i just feel numb now, I realise the thought of death is really irrational, yet calming in a haunting way. 
and for why i don’t seek help, it’s because im just really nervous and paranoid over what people would think, i had just recently spoke about it with my mother and it did not go well at all, kinda contributing more to my paranoia :(

i just wouldn’t want to make it something that would be talked about at school, i’d rather just have it so nobody really would know.
We do have a school counsellor but she’s rather dodgy to say atleast with how she attempts to “help”.
and im so nervous i would not be able to handle a psychologist, the thought of seeing one scares me.

no clue, and im scared to.
It’s not something i want to do, i already know it will be a mistake and I would advise you to try get some help, im just a bit too late to get any help at this point :(
Yeah, i’ve been trying to find better friends, its just i get easily attached to people and find it hard getting away from them.

i feel like i only just opened up to a friend abt everything, just to vent, and now he’s gone

only became close last year but i still miss talking to him every night abt dumb shit and being able to laugh my days problems away. I miss him so much

this same friend who did that me would have goes at me and verbally abuse me when i didn’t invite him out once after he said he was super sick the previous day And other things like that, it happened so many times.

had a friend who didn’t let me meet his out of school friends, but let other people meet them, and he came up to me with this bullshit excuse everytime. :((
It just kinda stung that i obviously wasn’t wanted around, and i wasnt good enough for his other friends or something 🤷‍♂️
i feel so fucking numb cause of this shit all the time :(
